verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say a dragged-in vendor invoice is automatically matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval and paid (ramp-docs-2), and that its agent learns from past invoices to apply that logic during processing. Human review is built in: approval routing, plus the guardrail that "no money ever moves without a human confirmation." Missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI extracts payment-specific fields (vendor bank details, amount, due date) from the bill, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-reading accuracy.
